prompt:
Minecraft builder reference sheet, landscape 3:2, crisp vanilla Minecraft voxel style, plain light background, no characters or animals. Two views side by side: LEFT straight-on front elevation, orthographic; RIGHT elevated three-quarter view of the same complete narrow lot at the same building scale, showing front, side and uphill rear garden. Skilled human builder quality: real massing and depth, projecting bay and trim, recessed framed openings, real roof edges with slab eaves, verges and parapet, sub-block stairs, slabs, fences, walls, trapdoors and lanterns. No smooth non-Minecraft architecture.

Site: A narrow San Francisco Italianate Victorian in four painted-lady colours, wedged between blank brick party walls on a steep street. Facing north onto a grey sidewalk, a rusticated grey-stone garage plinth carries a plum panelled garage door. A three-storey angled bay window rises from it: four-wide front face, stepped diagonal sides, tall narrow double-hung windows in plum sashes. Each window has a cream sill and a triangular plum-and-cream pediment hood. Gold fish-scale shingle spandrels mark each floor line, and cream corner boards run up every angle. To the right, a stone stoop with black iron handrails climbs four steps to a recessed entry porch framed by two cream columns. The porch has a small gold pediment over the entry and a panelled door with a transom deep inside. Above, a window pair sits over the porch on each upper floor. The whole front is sage-teal horizontal siding, topped by a deep cream cornice on paired plum brackets with a gold fish-scale frieze between them. The cornice wraps around the bay, and above it a flat false-front parapet carries a raised centre pediment and ball finials made of vanilla block approximations, hiding the flat roof; a brick chimney rises from the west party wall. A tiny front garden of flowers and shrubs sits behind a black iron fence on a stone curb, split by the drive apron and the stoop. Behind, the lot climbs: a timber deck with railings leaves the kitchen's French doors, steps drop to a lawn with a gravel path and flower borders along board fences, a shade tree stands on the lawn, and raised vegetable beds sit on a stone-kerbed upper terrace at the back fence.
Dimensions: lot 16 blocks wide, 50 deep; house 27 deep including bay; garage level plus 3 storeys; 18-19 blocks tall to parapet pediment. Keep both views consistent. Show the whole rear lot in right view without cutting away the house.

changes: Saved the generated image unchanged as concept.png in the current directory.

The palette retains every planned role block. Listed visible objects and added crop ids are visual interpretations, not recoverable block metadata; the raster cannot establish exact ids for every detail.

The image uses Minecraft-inspired custom geometry and textures in places: rounded cream finials, tiny mouldings, thin window sashes, detailed door panels, irregular foliage and pointed black railings are not faithful vanilla block shapes.
Cyan terracotta appears as horizontal siding with plank-like seams; vanilla cyan_terracotta has no siding texture, stairs or slabs.
Gold spandrels and frieze contain individually projecting small shingle shapes that yellow_terracotta and orange_terracotta cannot reproduce at the depicted scale.
The plum garage door is a custom multi-panel assembly. Crimson doors and trapdoors would approximate it but would not provide a working vanilla garage door.
The stoop has substantially more than the specified four steps.
The street and sidewalk appear nearly level across the frontage, so the steep street is not clearly represented.
The right-hand house appears smaller in projected height than the left elevation; the two views do not strictly maintain the same scale.
The left elevation reveals side depth around the bay and cornice, so it is not a perfectly strict orthographic front elevation.
The four-block bay front, 16-by-50 lot, 27-block house depth and 18–19-block height are not reliably countable or verified in this rendering.
The rear garden is visible through a gap beside the house; the depicted building and garden widths do not clearly preserve the planned narrow lot proportions.
The visible French doors open beneath or behind an elevated rear deck rather than clearly opening directly onto its surface.
The roof has a visible grey masonry perimeter parapet and exposed gravel surface in the elevated view.
Raised vegetable beds contain wheat-like and carrot-like crops, interpreted as wheat and carrots, which were absent from the supplied palette.
The image adds numerous lanterns inside windows, along the stoop, at the rear doors and on the back fence, plus potted porch plants.
The paired plum cornice brackets read mostly as repeated individual brackets rather than clearly separated pairs.
